Aisha (CSM): Quick heads up — Aurora AdOps reached out to expand. They want to onboard 3 additional teams for a publisher personalization pilot next week. Expect ~3x token volume in campaign bursts. Can we prioritize capacity + enablement?
Liam (Aurora - AdOps): Yes, that's right. Pilot starts Tuesday. Teams: personalization, QA, reporting. Peak ~150 req/s across teams. Latency is the main concern.
Priya (Account Exec): Renewal is Nov. This looks like a strong expansion signal — we should try a short Dedicated POC. Can you confirm forecast numbers (tokens/day, peak duration)?
Aisha (CSM): Baseline ~200k tokens/day. Pilot weeks will bump to ~600k tokens/day for ~2 weeks, then taper. Also they'll run reranking/embeds for candidate scoring.
Tom (Solutions Eng): We can support a hosted quota bump and quick autoscale, but Dedicated gives predictable latency. Need prompt/response sizes to estimate cost and batch impact.
Liam (Aurora - AdOps): Typical prompt ~250 tokens, reply ~350 tokens. Also ~50k embedding calls/day for rerank. Can we get a short Dedicated eval for the 2-week pilot?
Tom (Solutions Eng): Copy. I'll draft a test plan. Quick config snippet for load test and a smoke endpoint:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-2",
  "prompt": "<sample>",
  "max_tokens": 400
}
```
Tom (Solutions Eng): For cost/latency estimates I'll run a small sim with 150 req/s and those token sizes.
Aisha (CSM): I'll schedule an enablement session (30m) for each new team and capture playbook steps. We also need a short feedback form to track quality/regressions during the pilot.
Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll hook up evals + an hourly smoke test that checks latency and top-k rerank accuracy. Plan canary -> fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.
Priya (Account Exec): Marking this as expansion opp. I'll prepare a 2-week Dedicated POC quote and contract terms. Also adding a renewal acceleration note in case pilot expands.
infra-bot: Quota bump request submitted: ticket #CS-4821 — awaiting infra review.
Liam (Aurora - AdOps): Appreciate it. Can we run a 48h load test before the pilot? Latency SLAs are critical.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Yes — Wed 10am PT works. We’ll need an API key and a representative dataset (send via secure upload). I'll instrument traces.
Aisha (CSM): Action items: Priya -> POC contract/quote; Tom -> infra + load test + evals; Liam -> sample dataset + API key; Aisha -> enablement + feedback form. I'll follow up with calendar invites. :thumbsup:
Priya (Account Exec): Adding renewal watch and expansion notes in SFDC.
Liam (Aurora - AdOps): Sending dataset and expected traffic patterns today. Thanks all.
